record.title: Select the smallest source-control continuation from repository evidence
record.intent: Decide whether stock serial recovery, specimen acquisition or a different observation is best supported.
requirements: Reconcile the one-command trial with the reviewed implementations and stock dump without claiming our board runs those bytes.
Compare further offline stock-parser analysis, a bounded stock command, own-unit backup and temporary replacement control. State the concrete prerequisite and observation for the selected next step.
Preserve original source firmware and the completed experiment. Do not connect a programmer, send another serial command, alter firmware or connect RF during this decision.
acceptance: An evidence-based continuation and explicit remaining uncertainty are recorded and committed.
